title: Trump and Xi Jinping hold summit in Washington with state dinner and agricultural agreements
summary: U.S. and Chinese leaders seek to stabilize relations with promises of agricultural purchases and continued dialogue, while Japan analyzes geopolitical impact.

title: Victim's former son-in-law arrested for murder of woman in Gunma
summary: Police release arrest warrant against eldest daughter's ex-husband, suspected of stabbing woman and attempting to kill her son.

title: Typhoon 26 brings torrential rains, flooding, and traffic disruptions across much of Japan
summary: Typhoon leaves schools closed, one person missing in Chiba, and forces JFE steelworks to cut production due to flooding.

title: Father arrested for throwing two young daughters from sixth floor in Tokyo
summary: Girls aged 4 and 1 fell onto rescue mat set up by firefighters and survived; 25-year-old man arrested in the act.

title: OpenAI admits dozens of unauthorized external accesses and leak of user images
summary: Company reveals 53 training images and test data were posted on shared site, but asserts no malicious use occurred.

title: One month after Nepal landslide, aid focuses on mental health and climate warning
summary: Japanese nurse describes need for psychological support, while Nepalese prime minister links tragedy to climate change.

title: Japan shines in skating and marathon at Asian Games, but stands appear empty
summary: Hasegawa and Nagahara brothers win gold in skate, Yamashita wins marathon, though organizers boast high ticket sales.

title: Magnitude 4.5 earthquake shakes Kumamoto with no tsunami risk
summary: Shallow quake felt at intensity 4 on Japanese scale, no reports of serious damage.

title: Munetaka Murakami hits two home runs in a game, reaches 35 homers
summary: Yakult Swallows slugger punishes pitcher Sugano and leads home run league, while Okamoto hits key double.

title: 11-year-old prodigy Kurihara Yuzuki secures medal in Puyo Puyo at Asian Games
summary: Youngest member of Japanese delegation wins at least silver in esports tournament, cementing Japan as Puyo Puyo powerhouse.

title: Investigation into massive dumping of adult diapers in river affecting shijimi clam fishing
summary: Man sent to prosecutors for throwing about 8,000 used diapers; fishing cooperative fears serious reputational damage.

title: NTT Docomo raises rates up to 550 yen, shifts strategy from low cost to quality
summary: Japan's largest carrier increases basic plan prices to fund network improvements, marking end of price war in sector.

title: Tokyo Court declares total ban on election campaigning by under-18s unconstitutional
summary: Ruling finds restriction violates freedom of expression and calls for revision of Public Offices Election Act.

title: Financial markets rally: yen strengthens and stocks rise after U.S.-China summit and oil price drop
summary: Nikkei advances in futures, Dow Jones gains 478 points, dollar falls to 156 yen on expectations of trade de-escalation.
